recipes.name: Kristen's Bacon Ranch Potato Salad
ingredients_raw: 2 pounds red potatoes, cut into bite-size pieces

steps.text: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with lightly salted water; bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain; rinse under cold water until cool.

Combine sour cream and ranch dressing mix in a large bowl. Add potatoes, green onions, Cheddar cheese, and bacon; fold together until well-coated. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap; refrigerate before serving, about 2 hours.

raw_recipe.headline: Kristen's Bacon Ranch Potato Salad
raw_recipe.description: Kristen's bacon ranch potato salad recipe, with red potatoes, crispy bacon, Cheddar cheese, sour cream, and green onions, is delicious and easy to make.

video.description: In this video, we'll show you how to make Kristen's Creamy Bacon Ranch Potato Salad, a crowd-pleasing side dish perfect for barbecues and potlucks. This easy potato salad recipe features tender red potatoes, crispy bacon, sharp cheddar cheese, and a creamy ranch dressing. Learn how to combine these simple ingredients for a delicious and flavorful potato salad that everyone will love.

review.reviewBody: Simple and delicious, just what I needed. I used organic reds, reduced fat sour cream, homemade dry ranch dressing mix and New York sharp cheddar cheese. This was very easy to make which I appreciated on a chaotic day like today--I just combined the ingredients quickly this morning and let it sit all day in the fridge. And I'll tell you, the longer it sits, the better it gets!

Simple, easy and delicious! I love red potato salads and when you combine bacon and ranch - what's not to love? I always leave the skins on for red potato salads for a little bit of added color and flavor. I used light sour cream and Hidden Valley Ranch dressing mix. I mixed everything together and let it chill for a few hours and prettied it up with some additional thin sliced green onion on top. I might try this with bleu cheese next time for something a little different. Overall, very good - thanks for a great recipe KristenB!
I substituted sour cream for 12 ounces of plain Greek yogurt and used red potatoes. I also added hard boiled eggs. I ate a significant portion while in was making it. Very yummy.

I make a similar potato salad, but I add 2-3 stalk celery and 6 hard boiled eggs with the potatoes. I also use 1 lb bacon. I then mix in a separate bowl 1 cup mayo, 1 cup sour cream instead of 2 cups sour cream. I also add 1 pkg ranch dressing, 1/4 tsp garlic powder and a pinch of smoked paprika. Mix the salad dressing with the potatoes and add salt and pepper to taste. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. I like to make it the night before to pull together all the flavors. Everyone loves this potato salad.

I made this recipe as written using baby red potatoes and packaged real bacon pieces to save time. I will add I only cooked my potatoes 10 minutes after boiling and they were perfect. Any longer and they would have been too soft. My family, especially my husband, liked this recipe and gave it a mix of 4's and 5's.
I changed it up a bit by adding basil, 2 tbs, 1 cup of celery, 1/2 cup dill pickles and 1/4 cup of peprocini juice. It is delicious. Thank you, oh and I made it for 12 servings. J

It's a good one as is. Or if you like it bit more complex boil the potatoes in beef stock loaded with garlic , do your own bacon in the oven covered in sweet chili sauce. People will mow it down. I have family that despise potato salad. They eat like mad people.

I followed this exactly as I needed a quick party-pleaser without being mayo-based. It was outstanding. I saved a lot of time and mess by using store bought pre-cooked bacon (toasted in the toaster oven until very crisp).

This was an easy and delicious recipe. I didn't have red potatoes so I used russets. I also didn't have the packet of ranch dressing mix so I used bottled ranch dressing and reduced the amount of sour cream so I had a mixture about half sour cream and half bottled ranch dressing. I also used Gouda cheese because that's what I had. This recipe will be delish with whatever type of cheese you have. I also put some celery and some finely chopped red bell pepper. My husband thinks he likes this better than the regular style potato salad! Another reviewer said it had all the components of a loaded baked potato-- so, what's not to like? Thanks Kristin!! This recipe is definitely a keeper and I will be making it frequently!

Very simple and easy to make. I just made it to take to a summer neighborhood party. I did make one adjustment. The sour cream seemed to overpowering to me so I added 1/2 cup of Hellman's Mayo. That tamed it to perfection! Vic
Rich with flavor. I doubled the amount of potato’s, added 2 Cups of Sharp Cheddar and it worked quite well.

I was looking for a different potato salad recipe for a contest. I liked the ingredients in this one and the simplicity of making it. I made one slight addition to the ingredients by adding about 1/2 c finely chopped celery for a little crunch. This was delicious and it won the contest. I'll be making this again! One person said it was like eating a loaded baked potato. Very flavorful and delicious!!
I love love this potato salad. I call it loaded potato salad!!!
Yummy! I used Ken's Steakhouse Buttermilk Ranch instead of sour cream and ranch packets and added salt, pepper, and taco seasoning.
It was really good! My family loved it.
Loved this, goes great with bbq
I made the recipe as written. In the end I found it needed a lot more seasoning for our liking. Good base recipe.
was not impressed with this recipe. i made it again with mayo instead of sour cream and it makes all the difference in the world. much better.
This was the easiest potato salad I have ever made and delicious!!
